confirmedIntegrationDefects.evidence: Actual current production gate imports six repository singleton families with build=df78c5b while legacy consumers import build=2e3c45a. Overview also uses a different order-data query identity. Browser ESM instances therefore diverge.
confirmedIntegrationDefects.repair: Restore canonical unchanged repository cache identities and align the Overview order-data import. Regression proves six actual setter/getter families and all active consumers share the same module.

nativeAcceptance.remaining: Targeted recovery of five failed boundaries and opaque preview iframe checks.
nativeAcceptance.environmentFinding: Pinned Playwright browserContext.js directly reads navigator.serviceWorker in every frame; opaque sandbox frames throw SecurityError. Preserve their sandbox and use an equivalent registration-denial init script with SecurityError handling, worker-src none, unchanged kernel isolation and an explicit registration-denial assertion.
